how: scripts/perf/gate.py: exact instruction counts under cachegrind, Linux arm64 (gate.md, the speed-of-light lane's release run; x86 in gate-x86.md, from CI's perf job on probe PR #1346); Luau scenes the median of 3 heap placements
scenes_fields: change: the gate's own, from unrounded counts

notes.lab-stream: +0.37%: the font cache's file check (#1307) runs on a thread of its own, and once a process has had a second thread glibc locks its allocator for the rest of its life; the check moves to the host's idle tick after 0.1.8; on x86 it falls 0.63%
notes.script-update: like for like, the same bench and allocator on both sides (see redefined)

redefined.script-update: since 0.1.8 the cell leaves uncounted its bench's own data (#1321) and counts without glibc's fastbins (#1333). Both releases are counted that way, with v0.1.8's bench on v0.1.7: 1,008.6 M and 968.4 M on arm64, −3.98% (x86: 1,041.8 M and 1,000.4 M, −4.02%). Against v0.1.7's own bench the gate read −27.4%, which was the change of definition.
